title: A 2d action platformer I've been working on.
author: Glum_Quarter3485

comments.author: therealcoon
comments.body: Looks great. What's your workflow like

replies.author: Glum_Quarter3485
replies.body: Thanks! I'm using Godot. I use Claude Code to help with the coding  and some ai tools but I also bought asset packs for art. Did some sound design myself, then I put it all together and a lot of tweaks and testing myself. It's still only 3 weeks in development and far from over but it's starting to take shape.

replies.author: Glum_Quarter3485
replies.body: Thanks! I'll try to post more, it's still in early development

replies.author: Glum_Quarter3485
replies.body: Not quite a traditional Metroidvania at the moment. The current progression is more linear, focused on stylish combat, exploration and cinematic sequences. I do plan on adding revisitable areas with teleporters, hidden secrets, rewards and potentially new paths unlocked through abilities. I'm still figuring out how far I want to take that side of the game!
